folio.none: This reservation has no folio yet
folio.noneHint: It opens with the first charge or payment. Ask the front desk to post it.
folio.creditHint: The guest paid too much: refund the difference from the payments list.
folio.includesStay: Covers the whole stay, including nights the night audit has not posted yet.
folio.houseHint: Posted charges minus payments on this folio.
folio.paidMeter: Share of the stay already paid
folio.noCharges: No charges yet. Room nights are posted automatically every night.

link.title: Payment link
link.description: The guest pays online by card, PSE or Nequi. The payment lands on the folio by itself.

missing.whatsapp: The guest has no mobile number

link.qrHint: The guest can scan it with the phone camera.
link.sendError: The message could not be sent. Copy the link and share it yourself.
link.notSent: No message was sent. Copy the link and share it yourself.

payment.title: Record payment
payment.description: Money received at the front desk. It goes to the folio and to your cash shift.
payment.shiftRequired: Open your cash shift to take cash.
payment.amountRequired: Enter an amount greater than zero

charge.title: Add charge
charge.description: An extra from the hotel catalog or a charge you write yourself.
charge.noExtras: The hotel has no active extras
charge.noExtrasHint: Create them in Settings → Extras or use a manual charge.
charge.creditHint: Subtracts from the balance instead of adding.

risk.reasonPlaceholder: It stays in the folio history.
risk.voidChargeDescription: “{{description}}” ({{amount}}) stays on the folio, struck through, and no longer counts in the balance.
risk.voidRoomHint: Voiding a night does not change what the reservation owes: the stay total is still due and the night audit posts the night again. To give a discount, add an adjustment; to change the price, modify the stay.
risk.voidPaymentDescription: Only when the {{amount}} payment was recorded by mistake and the money never came in. To give money back use Refund.
risk.refundPending: Refund pending: follow the instructions on the folio
risk.refundDescription: {{amount}} paid by {{method}}. You can return up to {{refundable}}.
risk.refundTooMuch: Only {{refundable}} of this payment is left to return.
risk.refundHintCash: It comes out of the cash in your shift.
risk.refundHintSimulated: Simulated gateway payment: the refund is approved at once and moves no real money.
risk.refundHintCard: It is voided at Wompi (or Wompi is asked to refund it) and the money goes back to the guest's card.
risk.refundHintTransfer: Wompi is asked to refund it. If Wompi does not approve it, it stays pending until you transfer the money to the guest.
risk.refundHintOta: The OTA collected this money: it stays pending until you refund it on their extranet.
risk.completeDescription: Confirm what happened with the {{amount}} refund.

cashier.title: Cashier
cashier.description: Open your shift, follow what comes in and balance the drawer when you finish.
cashier.noShift: You have no open cash shift
cashier.noPermission: Ask the hotel admin for the cashier permission to open shifts.
cashier.openDescription: Count the cash you start with. The payments you record will belong to this shift.
cashier.expectedHint: Opening float + cash received − cash returned.
cashier.noMovements: No payments in this shift yet.
cashier.closeDescription: Count the cash in the drawer. Housetel compares the count with what should be there.
cashier.dayHint: Approved payments on the business date, minus refunds.

sim.notFound: We could not find this payment
sim.notFoundHint: Check the link or ask the hotel for a new one.
sim.footer: Housetel simulated gateway. To charge for real, the hotel connects Wompi in Settings → Integrations.
sim.bandText: No charge is real: you choose how the payment ends.
sim.nequiHint: With real Nequi you would get a notification in the app to accept the payment.
sim.testData: These are Wompi sandbox test details. Do not enter real data: here you pick the result with the buttons.
sim.approvedText: {{hotel}} received {{amount}}. The payment already shows on the reservation.
sim.closeTab: You can close this tab now.
sim.declinedText: The bank did not approve the payment and nothing was charged. You can try again.
sim.expiredText: Ask {{hotel}} for a new link to complete the payment.
